decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine was launched only in 2024 and extends the firm's core automation offer. Industry turnover is growing and the firm has engineering slack, so management has no clear shortfall against its aspirations yet, even though the earlier robots (A to D) disappeared quickly.

The production analysis software is cheap to maintain and complements the firm's controls and lifecycle-support business. It also supports the strategic push toward automated precast production, so there is little pressure to search for other uses of its resources.
